cards.name: Casa ES Raccolta Differenziata
cards.author: Casa ES
cards.description: Mostra cosa esporre questa sera e tre prossimi ritiri dal calendario Home Assistant.

changes: Shows tomorrow's collections as the waste to put out tonight.
Displays every waste type scheduled for the same collection day.
Replaces the weekly agenda with three compact, colour-coded upcoming collections.
Keeps all content inside one Oikos-themed panel.
Reads scheduled collections from calendar.raccolta_rifiuti.
Supports multiple collections on the same day and irregular dates.
Shows today, tomorrow and the next 3, 7 or 14 days.
Includes an installable Home Assistant package for the future-events sensor.
Recognises Sterpaglie, Umido, Carta, Vetro, Indifferenziata and Plastica.
